## Project Overview

I have chosen to focus my project on governmental response and use of Flock cameras. Flock cameras are an AI system of surveillance that 
police departments have unlimited access to. They have sparked lots of controversy over the ethicality of this type of surveillance and how 
police officers have been abusing the system. I plan on researching how each state is responding to the Flock cameras, either for or against. 
I also want to show how the states in different political parties are responding to the system. I want to find out if the political party of 
each state from the results of the 2024 election are related to the approval of Flock cameras.
